output:
echo 'dev tun
proto udp
remote 203.0.113.10 1194
ifconfig 10.8.0.1 10.8.0.2
secret /etc/openvpn/static.key' >> /etc/openvpn/site-to-site.conf

instruction: How to set up a simple OpenVPN site-to-site with static key
output:
echo 'dev tun
proto udp
remote 192.168.2.1 1194
ifconfig 10.8.0.2 10.8.0.1
route 192.168.2.0 255.255.255.0
secret static.key' >> /etc/openvpn/s2s-client.conf
